objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a 40-year-old woman who has presented with weakness and weight loss, and interpret her laboratory findings to make a diagnosis.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

“I’ve been feeling weaker over the last few months, and I’ve also unintentionally lost weight without changing my diet or exercise. I don’t have any urinary symptoms, but I’m worried about my kidney function because of a family history of kidney disease.”

How much weight have you lost, over what time period, and is the weakness generalized or mainly in certain muscles or activities?
How much weight have you lost, over what time period, and is the weakness generalized or mainly in certain muscles or activities?

“It’s been about 10 to 15 pounds over the past few months, and the weakness feels generalized rather than limited to specific muscles. I’ve noticed I tire more easily with normal day-to-day activities.”
Have you had any other symptoms such as fever, night sweats, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or new pain anywhere?
“I haven’t had fever or night sweats, and my appetite has been about the same. No nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or any new or unusual pain.”
Have you noticed increased thirst, urinating more than usual, getting up at night to urinate, or swelling in your legs or around your eyes?
“I haven’t noticed increased thirst, and I’m not urinating more than usual or getting up at night. I also haven’t noticed any swelling in my legs or around my eyes.”
Any blood in your urine, foamy urine, dark urine, flank pain, or a history of high blood pressure or diabetes?
“No blood in my urine, I haven’t noticed foamy urine or dark urine, and I don’t have flank pain. I don’t have a history of high blood pressure or diabetes, either.”
Have you had any palpitations, heat intolerance, tremor, anxiety, trouble sleeping, or changes in bowel frequency?
“I haven’t had palpitations or tremor, and I don’t feel heat intolerant or particularly anxious. My sleep has been about the same, and I haven’t noticed changes in bowel frequency.”
Any headaches, dizziness, fainting, darkening of the skin, salt craving, or nausea when standing up?
“I haven’t had headaches, dizziness, fainting, or darkening of my skin. I don’t have salt cravings, and I don’t get nausea when standing up.”
Have you noticed swollen lymph nodes, easy bruising, recurrent infections, bone pain, or bleeding?
“I haven’t noticed any swollen lymph nodes, easy bruising, or recurrent infections. I also haven’t had bone pain or any unusual bleeding.”
Any depressed mood, major stress, alcohol or drug use, or new medications or supplements?
“I haven’t had a depressed mood and no major stress changes that I can think of. I only drink alcohol socially, no drug use, and I haven’t started any new medications or supplements.”
What is your age, and do you have any known medical conditions or prior abnormal blood tests such as anemia, kidney function issues, thyroid problems, or liver problems?
“I’m 40 years old, and I don’t have any known medical conditions. I haven’t been told of any past abnormal blood tests like anemia or kidney, liver, or thyroid problems.”
Any change in your stools such as black stools, blood, or persistent abdominal discomfort?
“I haven’t noticed any black stools or blood, and I haven’t had persistent abdominal discomfort. My bowel habits have been the same.”

Are you having any increased fatigue with exertion, shortness of breath climbing stairs, or symptoms suggesting true muscle weakness like trouble rising from a chair, climbing stairs, lifting overhead, or frequent falls?

“Yes—I’m definitely more fatigued with normal exertion, like climbing stairs. I don’t have trouble rising from a chair, lifting overhead, or frequent falls, but I feel generally too weak to do what I used to.”

[ABSTAIN] Nonspecific weight loss and generalized fatigue/weakness without localizing symptoms is not enough to confidently narrow to a single cause.
[POSSIBLE] occult malignancy, anemia, chronic kidney disease, chronic infection, endocrine disorder (especially hyperthyroidism or adrenal insufficiency)

predicted_set: endocrine disorder (especially hyperthyroidism or adrenal insufficiency)
